   1 class_name MovementSystem extends System
   2 
   3 @export var runtime: Node = null
   4 var _placements: Dictionary = {}
   5 var _last_tick: int = -1

   7 
   8 func setup() -> void:
   9 	assert(is_instance_valid(runtime))
  10 
  11 func query() -> QueryBuilder:

  14 func process(entities: Array[Entity], _components: Array, delta: float) -> void:
  15 	if _room_epoch != runtime.room_epoch:
  16 		_room_epoch = runtime.room_epoch
  17 		_placements.clear()
  18 	if _last_tick != runtime.tick_index:
  19 		_last_tick = runtime.tick_index
  20 		_placements.merge(runtime.take_placements(), true)
  21 		for entity_id in _placements.keys():
  22 			if not runtime.world.entity_id_registry.has(entity_id):
  23 				_placements.erase(entity_id)
  24 	for entity in entities:
  25 		if not entity.enabled:
  26 			continue
  27 		var transform: C_Transform = entity.get_component(C_Transform)
  28 		var body: C_Body = entity.get_component(C_Body)
  29 		var motion: C_Motion = entity.get_component(C_Motion)
  30 		var hitbox: C_Hitbox = entity.get_component(C_Hitbox)
  31 		var visual: C_Visual = entity.get_component(C_Visual)
  32 		var root: Node2D = body.root if body != null else (visual.node.get_parent() if visual != null and is_instance_valid(visual.node) else null)
  33 		if body != null and (not body.ready or not is_instance_valid(root)):
  34 			continue
  35 		if body == null and visual != null and not is_instance_valid(root):
  36 			continue
  37 		var projectile: C_Projectile = entity.get_component(C_Projectile)
  38 		if _placements.has(entity.id):
  39 			var placement: Dictionary = _placements[entity.id]
  40 			transform.position = placement.position
  41 			transform.rotation = placement.rotation
  42 			transform.scale = placement.scale
  43 			if is_instance_valid(root):
  44 				root.global_position = transform.position
  45 				root.rotation = transform.rotation
  46 				root.scale = transform.scale
  47 				root.visible = true
  48 				if root is CollisionObject2D:
  49 					root.set_deferred("collision_layer", body.layer)
  50 					root.set_deferred("collision_mask", body.mask)
  51 				if body != null and is_instance_valid(body.shape):
  52 					body.shape.set_deferred("disabled", false)
  53 			if motion != null:
  54 				motion.velocity = Vector2.ZERO
  55 				motion.grounded = false
  56 				motion.jumps_used = 0
  57 				motion.coyote_left = 0.0
  58 				motion.buffer_left = 0.0
  59 				motion.placement_pending = false
  60 			if projectile != null:
  61 				projectile.previous_position = transform.position
  62 			_placements.erase(entity.id)
  63 			runtime.placement_completed(entity.id)
  64 			continue
  65 		if hitbox != null and hitbox.follows_owner:
  66 			var owner: Entity = runtime.world.entity_id_registry.get(hitbox.owner_id)
  67 			if is_instance_valid(owner):
  68 				transform.position = owner.get_component(C_Transform).position + hitbox.offset
  69 			continue
  70 		if delta <= 0.0 or motion == null or motion.placement_pending or not root is CharacterBody2D:
  71 			continue
  72 		var character: CharacterBody2D = root
  73 		if projectile != null:
  74 			if projectile.consumed:
  75 				continue
  76 			projectile.previous_position = transform.position
  77 			motion.velocity = projectile.direction.normalized() * projectile.speed
  78 			character.velocity = motion.velocity
  79 			var collision: KinematicCollision2D = character.move_and_collide(motion.velocity * delta)
  80 			transform.position = character.global_position
  81 			if collision != null:
  82 				var collider_entity: Node = collision.get_collider().get_parent()
  83 				runtime.record_projectile_contact(entity.id, collider_entity.id if collider_entity is GameEntity else "")
  84 			elif not runtime.room_bounds.grow(80.0).has_point(transform.position):
  85 				runtime.record_projectile_contact(entity.id)
  86 			continue
  87 		var input: C_Input = entity.get_component(C_Input)
  88 		var health: C_Health = entity.get_component(C_Health)
  89 		var combat: C_Combat = entity.get_component(C_Combat)
  90 		var axis: float = input.axis if input != null else 0.0
  91 		var controlled: bool = input != null and input.source == "player"
  92 		if controlled:
  93 			motion.desired_velocity.x = axis * motion.speed
  94 		if health != null and (health.dead or health.hurt_left > 0.0):
  95 			motion.desired_velocity = Vector2.ZERO
  96 			axis = 0.0
  97 		var dodging: bool = combat != null and combat.state == "dodge"
  98 		if dodging:
  99 			motion.velocity.x = motion.facing * 720.0
 100 		else:
 101 			if controlled:
 102 				motion.velocity.x = clampf(motion.velocity.x, -motion.speed, motion.speed)
 103 			motion.velocity.x = move_toward(motion.velocity.x, motion.desired_velocity.x, motion.acceleration * delta)
 104 		if absf(axis) > 0.01 and (combat == null or combat.state == "idle"):
 105 			motion.facing = 1 if axis > 0 else -1
 106 		if motion.gravity == 0.0:
 107 			motion.velocity.y = move_toward(motion.velocity.y, motion.desired_velocity.y, motion.acceleration * delta)
 108 		else:
 109 			motion.buffer_left = maxf(0.0, motion.buffer_left - delta)
 110 			motion.coyote_left = motion.coyote_duration if motion.grounded else maxf(0.0, motion.coyote_left - delta)
 111 			if input != null and input.jump_pressed and (health == null or not health.dead):
 112 				motion.buffer_left = motion.buffer_duration
 113 			motion.velocity.y = minf(motion.velocity.y + motion.gravity * delta, motion.max_fall_speed)
 114 			var first_jump: bool = motion.grounded or (motion.coyote_left > 0.0 and motion.jumps_used == 0)
 115 			var air_jump: bool = controlled and runtime.progression.moonstep and motion.jumps_used < 2
 116 			if motion.buffer_left > 0.0 and (first_jump or air_jump):
 117 				motion.velocity.y = -motion.jump_speed
 118 				motion.buffer_left = 0.0
 119 				motion.coyote_left = 0.0
 120 				motion.jumps_used = 1 if first_jump else 2
 121 				motion.grounded = false
 122 		character.velocity = motion.velocity
 123 		character.move_and_slide()
 124 		motion.velocity = character.velocity
 125 		var was_grounded: bool = motion.grounded
 126 		motion.grounded = character.is_on_floor()
 127 		if motion.grounded:
 128 			motion.jumps_used = 0
 129 			if not was_grounded and controlled:
 130 				runtime.landing_count += 1
 131 		var bounds: Rect2 = runtime.room_bounds
 132 		var edge: float = maxf(body.size.x * 0.5, 64.0 if controlled else 24.0)
 133 		var clamped_x: float = clampf(character.global_position.x, bounds.position.x + edge, bounds.end.x - edge)
 134 		if clamped_x != character.global_position.x:
 135 			character.global_position.x = clamped_x
 136 			motion.velocity.x = 0.0
 137 			character.velocity.x = 0.0
 138 		transform.position = character.global_position
